info.title: GeoTek API
info.description: GeoTek v2 local HTTP contract. Units: m, kPa, kN/m3 and degrees unless explicitly labelled otherwise. Non-finite result numbers are JSON null. The core shell, wall and sheet pile calculations, liquefaction and job polling are implemented. Remaining workflow stubs return ApiError with HTTP 501.

get.description: Report availability and the HTTP contract version.
Return the flat translation key-to-string catalog in the selected language.
List discovered modules sorted by menu order.
Return persisted application preferences.

put.description:
Persist library_dir and language (recent is server-managed and ignored).

The new library is resolved and created before anything is persisted; failure
returns 400 invalid_path and leaves the old settings in place.

get.description: List project files, newest first; unreadable files carry an error.

post.description: Create a project file in the library and open it as the current project.
Copy an existing project file into the library.

Import a project file sent as the raw request body (browser file picker).

``name`` only seeds the library file name; it is never used as a server path.

get.description: Send the stored project file to the browser as a download.

post.description: Open a library project as the current project (the old one stays on failure).
Copy a library project under a new unique file name.
Rename the project (and its file); the open project follows the new file.
Copy the stored project file outside the library; 409 file_exists unless overwrite.

delete.description: Move a project file to the library's .trash; refused while it is open.

get.description: Report whether a project is open, its library file and unsaved changes.

post.description: Create an unsaved project outside the library (saving needs a path).
Open a local project file by path, outside the library.
Save to the open library file, the path-based file, or an explicit path (Save As).
Close the open project, discarding unsaved changes.

get.description: Return the current project summary; 409 no_project_open when none.

patch.description: Update supplied metadata fields; omission preserves the existing value.

put.description: Select the profile used for investigation processing and liquefaction.

get.description: Read-only list of the open project's soil profiles (409 no_project_open when none).
List structures and their soil/result freshness state.

post.description: Create a wall or sheet pile with its own soil copy; choose the variant by kind.

get.description: Return a complete structure, discriminated by kind.

put.description: Replace a structure; the body id must identify the path resource.

delete.description: Delete a structure and return a JSON acknowledgement.

post.description: Re-copy soil from the structure's source project profile.

get.description: Poll status, progress, step translation key, result or error.

delete.description: Request cancellation and return the resulting job state.

get.description: List design codes in the project language and their named approaches.
Return code factor values and their provenance.
List missing factors for the selected approach and seismic/static case.

put.description: Replace the project's user factor overrides for one design code.

get.description: List raw borehole and CPT records.

post.description:
Import multipart file, sounding_id, qc_unit, delimiter and decimal form parts.

qc_unit applies to the file's cone resistance; stored sounding stresses are kPa.
Multipart parsing does not require the optional python-multipart package.
Import multipart file and borehole_id form parts.
Detect sheet roles, column mapping, units and open questions; nothing is stored.
Re-evaluate an edited plan against the file: units of re-mapped columns and open questions.
Build records from the file and the confirmed plan, then add them to the project.
Add a borehole entered by hand (SPT, log and laboratory records may follow later).

put.description: Replace a borehole; the body id must identify the path resource.

delete.description: Delete a borehole and return a JSON acknowledgement.

put.description: Replace the complete borehole log using a JSON array.
Replace a CPT sounding; the body id must identify the path resource.

delete.description: Delete a CPT sounding and return a JSON acknowledgement.

get.description: Return processed CPT chart data with null samples for non-finite values.

Return SBTn chart data; zones 8/9 are disabled by default and omitted.

Ic limits describe zones 2-7 before the zone-1 override, which has no Ic
interval. Contours use the lower-Qtn inverse branch, clipped to the chart
axes. The full zone-1 boundary is sampled even below the Qtn axis minimum.
Use the processed-CPT path, including its profile, warnings and errors.
Classify every lab record, preserving engine incompleteness and notes.

post.description: Classify stateless inputs; unavailable depth and PL are returned as null.

get.description: Sample LL=0..100%; preserve negative A/U-line values from the engine.
Return corrected SPT chart data.

post.description: Return a synchronous, unapproved CPT layering proposal.
Return a synchronous, unapproved SPT layering proposal.

get.description: List profiles available for selection or copying into structures.

post.description: Create from explicit layers or a proposal; assign profile and layer ids server-side.

get.description: Return a complete project soil profile.

put.description: Replace a profile; the body id must identify the path resource.

delete.description: Delete a project profile and return a JSON acknowledgement.

post.description: Split the selected layer at an absolute depth below ground.
Merge two adjacent layers in the selected profile.

get.description: Return parameter selections and candidates evaluated on the server.
Which inputs the layer's data provides and which correlations they enable.

put.description: Choose a method, statistic or manual value without approving it.

post.description: Approve only the explicitly listed design quantities.
Fill parameter suggestions throughout a profile; approve nothing.

Queue liquefaction for the project investigations; poll for LiquefactionResultDTO.

If ``profile_id`` is null the project's active profile is used; with no active profile
the server answers 409 ``no_soil_source``. An unknown ``profile_id`` answers 404
``not_found``.

get.description: Result saved in the open project; 404 ``not_found`` when no run has completed.
List selectable retaining wall types.

post.description: List missing design factors for this structure's selected workflow.
Queue wall_size; poll the job for WallResultDTO including proposed geometry.
Queue wall_check; poll the job for WallResultDTO.
Queue sheet_pile; poll the job for SheetPileResultDTO.

get.description: Return the module state stored in the open project (defaults when absent).

put.description: Replace the module state; a stored result must match its inputs.

post.description: Design one ground anchor; with ``save`` store inputs and result in the open project.
Analyse the anchored wall; with ``save`` store inputs and result in the open project.

get.description: Copy of a project soil profile for the analysis, with the source id and hash.
Source-labelled tendon and presumptive load-transfer tables and engine defaults.
List reportable sections with the state of their stored results.

post.description:
Build the .docx from stored results; stale or missing results are refused.

404 ``unknown_section``, 409 ``no_result`` / ``stale_result`` (details.sections lists
the ids), 422 ``empty_selection``.

ActiveProfileUpdate.title: ActiveProfileUpdate
ActiveProfileUpdate.description: Select a project profile; null restores the domain's first-profile fallback.

AnchorCheck.title: AnchorCheck
AnchorCheck.description: ``ok`` when demand <= limit; for ``overburden`` demand is the required cover, limit the available.

AnchorDefaults.title: AnchorDefaults
AnchorDefaults.description: Defaults the engine applies when the input is left out, each with its source.

AnchorDesignCommon.title: AnchorDesignCommon
AnchorDesignCommon.description:
Anchor design inputs shared by every level; geometry and load come from the analysis.

Same meaning and rules as ``AnchorDesignInputs``; nothing is assumed when left out.

AnchorLevel.title: AnchorLevel
AnchorLevel.description: One anchor row of the wall; loads are per metre of wall, anchors repeat at ``spacing``.

AnchorRecord.title: AnchorRecord
AnchorRecord.description: Stored anchor design: the inputs, the last result and the hash of its inputs.

AnchorReference.title: AnchorReference
AnchorReference.description: Source-labelled library for the UI; presumptive values are never applied silently.

surcharge_basis.title: Surcharge Basis
surcharge_basis.description: horizontal: the surcharge is a vertical load per horizontal projected area; inclined: per area of the inclined ground surface (q / cos(beta) per horizontal area)

AnchoredWallState.title: AnchoredWallState
AnchoredWallState.description: ``Project.modules["anchored_wall"]``; later phases add fields with defaults.

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: Shared error envelope; code is also the suffix of an error i18n key.

AppSettingsDTO.title: AppSettingsDTO
AppSettingsDTO.description: Persistent preferences; recent holds absolute paths, newest first (server-managed).

AssumptionDTO.title: AssumptionDTO
AssumptionDTO.description: Mirror of an engine assumption and its source label.

BasalHeaveResult.title: BasalHeaveResult
BasalHeaveResult.description: Bottom heave of a cut in clay, GEC-4 5.8.2.2 eq. 34-36 (Terzaghi et al. 1996).

energy_ratio.title: Energy Ratio
energy_ratio.description: Hammer energy ratio ER [%]; None is processed as 60 % with a warning

BoreholeLayer.title: BoreholeLayer
BoreholeLayer.description:
One logged interval of a borehole (field description). Gaps between intervals are
allowed (unlogged or no recovery); overlaps are not.

CPTProcessedDTO.title: CPTProcessedDTO
CPTProcessedDTO.description: Depth-aligned CPT chart series; stresses in kPa, friction ratios and fc in percent.

CPTSounding.title: CPTSounding
CPTSounding.description: CPT(u) record. Stresses stored in kPa (convert MPa at import).

stem_height.title: Stem Height
stem_height.description: From top of base to top of stem

toe.title: Toe
toe.description: Toe projection in front of the stem

embedment.title: Embedment
embedment.description: Front soil level above base bottom (D)

CantileverGeometry.title: CantileverGeometry
CantileverGeometry.description: Reinforced concrete cantilever wall; stem back face vertical, front face battered.

CheckDTO.title: CheckDTO
CheckDTO.description:
CheckResult with case and utilisation supplied by the future API adapter.

Utilisation is required/value for >= and value/required for <=. It is null
for non-finite or absent values (and undefined division).

DeletionResponse.title: DeletionResponse
DeletionResponse.description: JSON acknowledgement of a deleted investigation, profile or structure.

DesignCodeSummary.title: DesignCodeSummary
DesignCodeSummary.description: Design code name in project language, factor scheme and named approaches.

DesignParameters.title: DesignParameters
DesignParameters.description: Characteristic values confirmed by the engineer; Module 2 reads these.

ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest
ExportRequest.description: Destination file or directory outside the library.

ExportResponse.title: ExportResponse
ExportResponse.description: Resolved path of the exported copy.

FactorOverride.title: FactorOverride
FactorOverride.description: A user-entered factor value. ``note`` should say why (e.g. project specification).

FactorRowDTO.title: FactorRowDTO
FactorRowDTO.description: Mirror of a factor table row; null means no supplied factor value.

ForceDTO.title: ForceDTO
ForceDTO.description: Force dataclass mirror; fx/fy in kN/m and x/y in metres from the toe.

back_offset.title: Back Offset
back_offset.description: Horizontal set-back of the back face top from the heel

GravityGeometry.title: GravityGeometry
GravityGeometry.description: Trapezoidal gravity wall: base width B, top width, back face offset at the top.

GroundwaterCondition.title: GroundwaterCondition
GroundwaterCondition.description: Groundwater depths [m below ground]. Design and seismic default to in-situ.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Local API availability and contract version.

ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest
ImportRequest.description: Existing project file to copy into the library.

JobRef.title: JobRef
JobRef.description: Handle for a submitted background computation.

JobState.title: JobState
JobState.description: Pollable job state; result and error are null until applicable.

sample_id.title: Sample Id
sample_id.description: Sample label in the source file

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Derivation notes, e.g. which test reduction produced a value

LayerInventory.title: LayerInventory
LayerInventory.description: Input availability of a layer and the correlations it enables, nothing assumed.

LayerMerge.title: LayerMerge
LayerMerge.description: Exactly two adjacent layer ids to merge; order does not imply approval.

LayerSplit.title: LayerSplit
LayerSplit.description: Depth below ground at which to split the selected layer [m].

LayeringProposal.title: LayeringProposal
LayeringProposal.description: Layer interpretation and reproducible settings for one investigation.

min_thickness.title: Min Thickness
min_thickness.description: Thinner zones merge into a neighbour [m]

merge_ic_tol.title: Merge Ic Tol
merge_ic_tol.description: Adjacent zones with |dIc| below this merge

n_change_ratio.title: N Change Ratio
n_change_ratio.description: SPT: relative N change that starts a new layer

LayeringSettings.title: LayeringSettings
LayeringSettings.description:
Automatic layering options, stored with the profile so the result can be reproduced.

Defaults are algorithm settings (not code or correlation coefficients) and are editable.

LibraryEntryDTO.title: LibraryEntryDTO
LibraryEntryDTO.description: Project file in the library; error is non-null when the file could not be read.

LiquefactionResultDTO.title: LiquefactionResultDTO
LiquefactionResultDTO.description: Results and independent failures keyed by investigation id.

LiquefactionSettingsDTO.title: LiquefactionSettingsDTO
LiquefactionSettingsDTO.description: Explicit liquefaction inputs; the contract chooses no engineering coefficients.

MessageDTO.title: MessageDTO
MessageDTO.description: Stable message identifier and interpolation parameters.

MethodAvailability.title: MethodAvailability
MethodAvailability.description: One registry correlation and how many layer points can feed it.

MissingFactorDTO.title: MissingFactorDTO
MissingFactorDTO.description: Mirror of a missing code factor, including provenance and the entry hint.

ModuleInfo.title: ModuleInfo
ModuleInfo.description: Discovered module metadata for the launcher, sorted by order.

NewProjectRequest.title: NewProjectRequest
NewProjectRequest.description: Subset of ProjectMeta needed to create a library project.

ParameterApproval.title: ParameterApproval
ParameterApproval.description: Design quantities the engineer explicitly approves.

ParameterSelection.title: ParameterSelection
ParameterSelection.description:
Engineer's choice for one quantity of one layer, with the candidates it was made from.

``candidates`` holds one entry per applicable correlation (or lab/user source), each a
layer-representative value whose ``stats`` give the spread over the depth points inside
the layer. ``suggested`` is the program's proposal. The engineer picks a correlation, a
statistic over the candidates, or enters a value; ``selected`` is the resolved value with
its trace. Only approved selections are written to ``SoilLayer.design``.

ParameterStats.title: ParameterStats
ParameterStats.description: Spread when several correlations were evaluated for the same parameter.

PressureDiagramDTO.title: PressureDiagramDTO
PressureDiagramDTO.description: PressureDistribution chart projection; stresses kPa, force kN/m, depths m.

ProfileCreate.title: ProfileCreate
ProfileCreate.description:
Create from exactly one of explicit layers or an unapproved layering proposal.

Groundwater and origin are explicit in both modes. A proposal does not supply
approved design parameters or missing unit weights automatically.

ProfileSummary.title: ProfileSummary
ProfileSummary.description: Profile picker entry with origin, sources, groundwater and layer count.

ProjectCounts.title: ProjectCounts
ProjectCounts.description: Counts of each top-level project collection.

ProjectMetaPatch.title: ProjectMetaPatch
ProjectMetaPatch.description:
Partial ProjectMeta; omitted fields are unchanged and explicit null is invalid.

Consumers use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) when applying the patch. Placeholder
None defaults permit omission but are not accepted as supplied field values.

ProjectNew.title: ProjectNew
ProjectNew.description: Name and UI language for a new project.

ProjectSave.title: ProjectSave
ProjectSave.description: Save destination; null or omission uses the current project file.

ProjectSaveResponse.title: ProjectSaveResponse
ProjectSaveResponse.description: Session state after a save plus the path written (library or path-based).

ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary
ProjectSummary.description: Project metadata, site settings, counts, profile selection and structure state.

ProposedLayer.title: ProposedLayer
ProposedLayer.description: Interpreted interval; suggested values remain unapproved engineering inputs.

RenameRequest.title: RenameRequest
RenameRequest.description: New project name for a library file.

ReportRequest.title: ReportRequest
ReportRequest.description: Section ids to include; null means every section whose result is current.

ReportSectionDTO.title: ReportSectionDTO
ReportSectionDTO.description: One reportable block; ``status`` says whether its stored result is usable.

RetainingWallCreate.title: RetainingWallCreate
RetainingWallCreate.description:
Retaining wall inputs without a server id; omitted soil uses the selected profile.

profile_id selects the copy source, falling back to the active profile when null.
Explicit soil and profile_id are alternative sources. Heights are depths in metres.

If ``soil`` is null, ``profile_id`` is null and the project has no active profile, the
server answers 409 ``no_soil_source``; the client must then send an explicit manual
``soil`` with ``source_profile_id=null``.

height.title: Height
height.description: Base bottom to top of wall = base depth z [m]

SBTNCoordinateDTO.title: SBTNCoordinateDTO
SBTNCoordinateDTO.description: Chart coordinate: Fr in percent and dimensionless Qtn.

SPTProcessedDTO.title: SPTProcessedDTO
SPTProcessedDTO.description: Depth-aligned SPT chart series; API labels map to n_field, n60 and n1_60.

blows.title: Blows
blows.description: Blows per 150 mm increment: seating drive, then the two counted drives

SelectionUpdate.title: SelectionUpdate
SelectionUpdate.description: Selection inputs only; server resolves candidates and leaves approval separate.

SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo
SessionInfo.description: Open-project state of the running server.

ShearKey.title: ShearKey
ShearKey.description:
Concrete shear key (kayma dişi) cast under the base slab; a full-length strip, per metre of wall.

``position`` places the key under the toe, the middle of the base or the heel; ``width`` is its
horizontal size and ``depth`` how far it projects below the base bottom.

ShearKeyResultDTO.title: ShearKeyResultDTO
ShearKeyResultDTO.description: Shear key result of one design case.

SheetPileCreate.title: SheetPileCreate
SheetPileCreate.description:
Sheet pile inputs without a server id; profile selection matches retaining walls.

If ``soil`` is null, ``profile_id`` is null and the project has no active profile, the
server answers 409 ``no_soil_source``; the client must then send an explicit manual
``soil`` with ``source_profile_id=null``.

SheetPileResultDTO.title: SheetPileResultDTO
SheetPileResultDTO.description:
SheetPileResult mirror plus structure id, total length and service assumptions.

Engine names are retained: H is retained height, D0 theoretical embedment,
D design embedment, M_max maximum moment [kNm/m], z_M_max its depth [m],
and net the net pressure [kPa]. total_length is H + D [m].
section_modulus_cm3 retains the engine's explicit cm3 unit exception.

backfill_slope.title: Backfill Slope
backfill_slope.description: Retained ground slope beta [deg]; front side stays horizontal

surcharge_basis.title: Surcharge Basis
surcharge_basis.description: horizontal: the surcharge is a vertical load per horizontal projected area; inclined: per area of the inclined ground surface (q / cos(beta) per horizontal area)

SlipCircleDTO.title: SlipCircleDTO
SlipCircleDTO.description: Critical SlipResult circle per case; non-finite safety factor becomes null.

LPI.title: Lpi
LPI.description: Liquefaction Potential Index (Iwasaki); null if every point is invalid

LPI_incomplete.title: Lpi Incomplete
LPI_incomplete.description: True when some points are invalid, so the LPI may be understated

SoundingLiquefactionDTO.title: SoundingLiquefactionDTO
SoundingLiquefactionDTO.description: Depth-aligned triggering series; CSR/CRR/FS map to engine csr/crr/fs.

StateResponse.title: StateResponse
StateResponse.description: Stored module state plus whether the stored anchor result still matches its inputs.

StoredLiquefactionDTO.title: StoredLiquefactionDTO
StoredLiquefactionDTO.description: The liquefaction result saved in the project, with the settings it was computed with.

StructureSummary.title: StructureSummary
StructureSummary.description: Structure list entry; stale indicates changed source soil or analysis inputs.

TendonSpec.title: TendonSpec
TendonSpec.description: Prestressing steel selection; ``None`` library id / count means choose automatically.

TrashResponse.title: TrashResponse
TrashResponse.description: Location of a deleted library file inside the library's .trash directory.

USCSClassifyRequest.title: USCSClassifyRequest
USCSClassifyRequest.description: Stateless engine inputs, with the same numeric bounds as LabRecord.

USCSItemDTO.title: USCSItemDTO
USCSItemDTO.description: Lab result; depth and PL are null for stateless classify() requests.

UsedFactorDTO.title: UsedFactorDTO
UsedFactorDTO.description: Mirror of geotek.config.codes.UsedFactor with finite JSON representation.

surcharge.title: Surcharge
surcharge.description: Uniform surcharge on the retained side [kPa]

surcharge_basis.title: Surcharge Basis
surcharge_basis.description: horizontal: the surcharge is a vertical load per horizontal projected area; inclined: per area of the inclined ground surface (q / cos(beta) per horizontal area)

sds.title: Sds
sds.description: TBDY S_DS; None = no seismic case

r.title: R
r.description: TBDY Table 16.7 r; None = by wall type

WallResultDTO.title: WallResultDTO
WallResultDTO.description: Wall sizing or checking result, with proposed geometry and traceable evidence.

WallSection.title: WallSection
WallSection.description: Generic wall section: strength check only, no steel or concrete design.

WallTypeInfo.title: WallTypeInfo
WallTypeInfo.description: Selectable retaining wall type and its i18n label key.

WorkbookImportResult.title: WorkbookImportResult
WorkbookImportResult.description: Records added by a workbook import, with translatable warning codes.
